limitation_observed: A 400-ms bilateral source pair altered command and yaw but both bearing errors worsened; no source pursuit demonstrated. One longer biological trajectory can falsify delayed orientation, not prove feedback.
operation: Extend the unchanged PN629-off full organism, source, motor, geometry and Gaussian boundary to 1000 ms from the same 40-ms odor-free preparation. No wind or 30-degree teleport.
legal_information: Only the 400-ms exposed pair, its fixed source, measured motor limit and frozen numerical setup. No 1000-ms neural or body outcome has been observed.

rivals.A: Delayed correction emerges within 1 s: absolute bearing error decreases materially from preparation and from 400 ms.
rivals.B: Early source-driven turn persists or reverses without material bearing improvement by 1 s.
rivals.C: Clock, field, preparation, support, prefix or numerical integrity fails; no biological interpretation.

controls_and_limit: The first 400 ms are compared with the historical same-arm trace and raw field/motor equations are rebuilt. This is a one-arm screening run; matched sham/yoked and numerical reference are required before any Stage4 admission.

fixed_inputs.source_design: lateral offset 1.5 antenna baselines; sigma 1.5 baselines; forward offset is the unique nonnegative solution that matches the old prepared bilateral mean

preflight.guard_basis: Seven already exposed Stage3 prepared poses: maximum common pair discrepancy 4.0118686151e-11 and prior-common discrepancy 2.0018653402e-11. The 1e-10 bounds are input/pose identity tolerances, not a change to neural, motor or numerical-effect criteria.

observation.scope: Raw per-ms body, sensors, DN and signed flow; observer at ten fixed epochs.

screen.meaning: A positive screen only triggers matched controls; it is not a Stage4 pass. A negative screen rejects delayed bearing correction for this arm and horizon.

stop: No retuning of source, gain, reader, horizon, thresholds or solver after outcome. Preserve incomplete attempts. Stage4 and Stage5 remain open unless separate causal controls pass.
